RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias. Group head positions prioritize client development, commercial acumen, and leadership style over pure technical tenure. Both of you met core chartered qualifications, and her highlighted client relationships represent critical criteria for executive appointments. 

A two-week wait for written feedback is standard HR turnaround, not proof of impropriety. Alleging gender discrimination without concrete evidence will severely damage your professional reputation, alienate industry peers, and eliminate future opportunities with the firm. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on leadership competencies. Only consider escalating if documented evidence of discriminatory hiring practices surfaces.
